As Craig changed into his gear, he caught snippets of conversation about the previous night's training session. "Did you see Dobson's shot from the halfway line?" Marius exclaimed. "It was like a rocket, I swear!" Alexandru chuckled, shaking his head. "You think that's impressive, wait till you see him take on the Rapid defense." Craig blushed, feeling a surge of pride and gratitude towards his teammates. He had worked tirelessly to adapt to the Romanian style of play, and it seemed to be paying off. As he made his way to the pitch for the pre-match warm-up, he caught a glimpse of the FC Dunărea Călărași crest emblazoned on his jersey – a symbol of his new home, and the team that had welcomed him with open arms.
